To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All contracts, task orders, modifications, awards, and insurance policies or binders between your agency and Safety National, Safety National Casualty Corporation, Tokio Marine Holdings, Inc., Tokio Marine HCC, Tokio Marine America Insurance Company, Houston Casualty Company, U.S. Specialty Insurance Company, or Philadelphia Indemnity Insurance Company, from January 1, 2022 to the present.
Please include the contract number, contractor name and UEI, period of performance, obligated and ceiling value, contracting office, and a copy of the base award and modifications.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Fecteau

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Military service records concerning below:
Name: Samuel Foster
Branch: United States Army
DOB: 3 March 1959 
Dates of Service: Approx yrs 1978 to 1998

Please provide the following documents 
1. copy of Joint service commendation award citation
2. copy of Army commendation award citations
3. copy of Meritorious Service Medal citation 
4. copy of Army Achievement medal citation 
5. Section II Military Education/ training courses form
6. Section V MISCELLANEOUS Form
7. Dates of service, date of discharge from active duty 
8. Historical Assignments

I request hard copies of paperwork in the file showing this information. Please redact per U.S.C. § 552(b)(6).
Please mail hardcopies to following:
MUCKROCK NEWS 
DEPT MR#
263 HUNTINGTON AVE
BOSTON, MA 02115

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eric Bradley
